subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

When it comes to planning her wedding, Maria wants _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"The whole nine yards"** means everything possible or available; the whole lot. (पूरी कोशिश करना)

 
 
• **Example: **When it comes to planning her wedding, Maria wants the** whole nine yards**, from a grand ceremony to an extravagant reception.
 
 
 
• Here in this sentence this phrase only suits well as the given statement is appropriate to option 4 in terms of meaning.

Therefore the correct sentence is **When it comes to planning her wedding, Maria wants the whole nine yards__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Down for the count** (हार जाना): To be defeated or out of action.

 
 
• **Example:** After working non-stop for two days, I was **down for the count **and needed rest.
 
 
 
• **A black sheep **(कुल कलंक): Someone who is considered a disgrace or an outsider within a family or group.
 
 
• **Example:** John is the **black shee**p of the family, always getting into trouble.
 
 
 
• **The whole fifteen miles** (पूरा पंद्रह मील): This is not a commonly used phrase and does not fit the context.
